icu.notes: fr adds two plural blocks in file_preview_cap (one/many/other on size and cap) and keeps {size, number, ::group-off}/{cap, number, ::group-off} inside every arm; every other locale keeps the English shape. No locale introduces an argument English does not declare, so no translation can demand a parameter the call sites do not pass. English has no plural/select blocks in this namespace, so there are no English arms to mirror; fr's added arms are locale-correct CLDR categories (one/many/other) and are unreachable in practice because the message only renders when size > cap > 1.

hygiene.notes: Checked per value: NFC normalisation, U+200E/U+200F/U+202A-E/U+2066-9/U+061C presence, surrounding whitespace, bracket balance, double spaces, and terminal sentence punctuation against English (۔ and ۔/。 counted as sentence terminators for ur and zh-CN).
